eee0748b00de21d9.en: Apply Article 11, part 12: the insurer refunds the premium less the portion proportional to the period of coverage.
eee0748b00de21d9.zh: 适用第11条第12款：保险人退还保费，扣除与已生效保障期间成比例的部分。

9d197809f7f08c0e.en: The loan is repaid; thirty days passed long ago
9d197809f7f08c0e.zh: 贷款已还清，三十天早已过去

b25b77f49fedbc3c.en: Apply Article 11, part 12: the insurer refunds the premium less the portion proportional to the period of coverage. Expiry of the initial thirty days does not resolve the question of a refund after full early repayment. The grounds and amount of the refund differ.
b25b77f49fedbc3c.zh: 适用第11条第12款：保险人退还保费，扣除与已生效保障期间成比例的部分。最初三十天届满，并不能回答全部提前履行贷款义务后能否退款的问题。退款的依据和范围不同。

9056bb2b20315908.en: Article 11, part 12 automatically requires the entire premium without deducting coverage already provided.
9056bb2b20315908.zh: 第11条第12款自动要求退还全部保费，不扣除已提供保障的部分。

ab60e2d4e769039b.en: Check the policy parties, purpose of the insurance and cancellation conditions.
ab60e2d4e769039b.zh: 核对保单当事人、保险目的和退保条件。

63aa91caa14ed1e8.en: Establish when the insurer received the written application.
63aa91caa14ed1e8.zh: 确定保险人收到书面申请的日期。

d919df0089e775c4.en: Prepare a justified route for a full premium refund.
d919df0089e775c4.zh: 拟定有依据的全额退还保费办理路径。

b74a48de45967307.en: Explain separately that the loan and interest-rate terms require their own review.
b74a48de45967307.zh: 另行说明，贷款和利率条款需要单独核查。

d2f8955c46def03e.en: Verify the refund under ИС-11, not merely the contract termination note.
d2f8955c46def03e.zh: 核查ИС-11项下的实际退款，而不只看合同终止记录。

060a33506eaf90a2.en: Guarantee an unchanged loan interest rate without checking the contract.
060a33506eaf90a2.zh: 不核查合同就保证贷款利率不变。

5ea95a4611adf5d3.en: Refuse solely because fourteen days have elapsed.
5ea95a4611adf5d3.zh: 仅因十四天已过就拒绝。

96d8c84f12d68f31.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. Individual voluntary insurance secures a consumer loan. The borrower is the policyholder. The insurer duly received the written cancellation within 30 calendar days of conclusion; no compulsory mortgage insurance is involved. There are no events indicating an insured event. The first notice to the bank preceded receipt by the insurer, but the bank was not authorised to accept this cancellation on the insurer's behalf.
96d8c84f12d68f31.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。个人自愿保险用于保障消费贷款，借款人本人为投保人。保险人在合同订立后30个日历日内正式收到书面退保申请；不涉及强制住房抵押保险。没有发生具有保险事故特征的事件。首次通知银行的时间早于保险人收件时间，但银行无权代表保险人接收本次退保申请。

179d3f974d8eae18.en: Article 11, part 11 of Law No. 353-ФЗ. First identify the triggering event.
179d3f974d8eae18.zh: 第353-ФЗ号法律第11条第11款。首先确定起算事件。

2035bebfd26747f1.en: Insurer's deadline for refunding the premium following the application
2035bebfd26747f1.zh: 保险人根据申请退还保费的截止日期

872fcbecc79b55c0.en: In the base version, the bank was the policyholder. Here the borrower herself is the policyholder: the recipient of the demand changes, while the receipt date is established separately.
872fcbecc79b55c0.zh: 基础情景中，银行是投保人。本情景中，借款人本人是投保人：请求的接收方发生变化，而收件日期仍须单独确定。

16193c74981ef236.en: Part 11: timely cancellation by the borrower-policyholder of voluntary insurance securing a loan within 30 calendar days entitles them to the full premium, refunded by the insurer no later than seven working days after the written application. Part 12: following full early repayment of the loan, the insurer refunds the premium less the portion proportional to coverage already provided, within the same period after the application. Part 10: for the group personal insurance specified by law, the creditor or a person acting in its interests makes the refund; the basis is the premium payable to the insurer for that borrower, less the time already used. All three exercises explicitly stipulate no events indicating an insured event. Not every bank service is an insurance premium.
16193c74981ef236.zh: 第11款：借款人兼投保人在30个日历日内及时申请解除保障贷款的自愿保险，有权获得全额保费，保险人应在收到书面申请后不迟于七个工作日退还。第12款：贷款全部提前履行后，保险人在收到申请后的相同期限内退还保费，但须扣除与已生效保障期间成比例的部分。第10款：对于法律规定的团体人身保险，由债权人或代表其利益行事的人退款；计算基数是就该借款人向保险人支付的保费，扣除已使用期间对应的部分。三个练习均明确设定没有发生具有保险事故特征的事件。银行的每一项服务并不都等于保费。

b9e92be7a71c8ec0.en: The reply mentions fourteen days and agreement with the bank. It provides no evidence of an amended insurance contract or another applicable regime.
b9e92be7a71c8ec0.zh: 答复提到十四天及与银行协商，但未提供保险合同变更或适用其他制度的证据。

0a857b1259c3f234.en: The policyholder field names Maria. The premium was paid to the insurer; the insurance secures a consumer loan. This is not enrolment in a contract where the bank is the policyholder.
0a857b1259c3f234.zh: “投保人”栏填写的是玛丽亚。保费已支付给保险人，保险用于保障消费贷款。这并非加入以银行为投保人的保险合同。

c506425f832a37ba.en: The insurer received the signed application on {{recipientReceived}}, the twentieth calendar day after conclusion. The absence of events indicating an insured event is confirmed. The earlier letter to the bank was received on {{received}}.
c506425f832a37ba.zh: 保险人在{{recipientReceived}}收到已签署的申请，即合同订立后的第二十个日历日。已确认没有发生具有保险事故特征的事件。此前寄给银行的信于{{received}}收到。

027ac2e75ba0f0ce.en: Event: {{observed}}. The letter was sent on {{sent}}, received by the specified reception office or unit on {{received}}, and registered on {{registered}}. The insurer received the duly submitted application on {{recipientReceived}}.
027ac2e75ba0f0ce.zh: 事件日期：{{observed}}。信件于{{sent}}寄出，于{{received}}送达指定接待处或部门，于{{registered}}登记。保险人于{{recipientReceived}}收到符合要求的申请。

dd6b856db04e2451.en: The borrower is the policyholder; timely cancellation was received by the proper recipient, the insurer. In the base version, the bank was the policyholder. Here the borrower herself is the policyholder: the recipient of the demand changes, while the receipt date is established separately.
dd6b856db04e2451.zh: 借款人是投保人；及时提交的退保申请已由适格接收方——保险人收到。基础情景中，银行是投保人。本情景中，借款人本人是投保人：请求的接收方发生变化，而收件日期仍须单独确定。

0f7aadb2aa11cb7b.en: The borrower is the policyholder; timely cancellation was received by the proper recipient, the insurer.
0f7aadb2aa11cb7b.zh: 借款人是投保人；及时提交的退保申请已由适格接收方——保险人收到。

0cc0d74298aca747.en: Any loan-related policy makes the bank the policyholder.
0cc0d74298aca747.zh: 任何与贷款有关的保单都会使银行成为投保人。

c120c4f93f9761ea.en: After the fourteenth day there is no right to a refund in any circumstances.
c120c4f93f9761ea.zh: 第十四天之后，在任何情况下都无权退款。

1d6baa266024bd25.en: The insurer confirmed termination, but the payment order bears another policy number, ИС-12.
1d6baa266024bd25.zh: 保险人确认合同已终止，但付款指令上的保单号是另一份保单ИС-12。

7076b8ef73bed962.en: Verify the actual refund under ИС-11; termination and an unrelated payment do not prove that the demand was fulfilled.
7076b8ef73bed962.zh: 核查ИС-11项下的实际退款；合同终止和不相关付款不能证明请求已履行。

e92e144498cea9ad.en: Close the case on the basis of any payment order.

91188062c0391bb5.en: Declare the loan terminated together with the insurance.
91188062c0391bb5.zh: 宣布贷款随保险一起终止。

0bb7077aadc37e0f.en: Count the refund period from any earlier letter to the bank.
0bb7077aadc37e0f.zh: 从任何较早寄给银行的信开始计算退款期限。

652aefce7052e578.en: Apply fourteen days as an unconditional limit for this cancellation.
652aefce7052e578.zh: 将十四天作为本次退保不可例外的期限。

618d04b796012158.en: Find the legal basis for the next action: apply Article 11, part 11: a full premium refund by the insurer following timely cancellation under the stated conditions.
618d04b796012158.zh: 查找下一步行动的法律依据：适用第11条第11款，在既定条件下及时退保，由保险人全额退还保费。

975abce07e18382d.en: The bank sold me a policy with the loan. I am the policyholder in the contract. I cancelled on the twentieth day, but they quote the old fourteen-day rule and are waiting for the bank's decision.
975abce07e18382d.zh: 银行办理贷款时向我出售了保单。合同中的投保人是我。我在第二十天申请退保，但他们却引用旧的十四天规定，还要等待银行决定。

254f2ab11c6245a6.en: Analysis of compliance with a refund demand under Article 11, part 11 of Law No. 353-ФЗ.
254f2ab11c6245a6.zh: 分析第353-ФЗ号法律第11条第11款项下退款请求的履行情况。

1487f857acea0ca5.en: Who is named as the policyholder?

ea1cebf3f22fcbb3.en: When did the insurer receive the cancellation?
ea1cebf3f22fcbb3.zh: 保险人何时收到退保申请？

71d4204bfb0b2507.en: Were there any events indicating an insured event?
71d4204bfb0b2507.zh: 是否发生过具有保险事故特征的事件？

b673916442557979.en: No, the first letter was only to the bank.
b673916442557979.zh: 没有，第一封信只寄给了银行。

beec04d5672775c6.en: Was the bank accepting applications on behalf of the insurer?
beec04d5672775c6.zh: 银行是否代表保险人接收申请？

c292f9cb0c40725f.en: Reception specialist for financial consumer protection
c292f9cb0c40725f.zh: 金融消费者权益保护接待专员

4c6651d117cf915d.en: The insurer under individual contract ИС-11 that received the written cancellation.
4c6651d117cf915d.zh: 收到书面退保申请的个人保险合同ИС-11的保险人。

e22281df3f5539de.en: Apply Article 11, part 11: a full premium refund by the insurer following timely cancellation under the stated conditions.
e22281df3f5539de.zh: 适用第11条第11款，在既定条件下及时退保，由保险人全额退还保费。

e499b1701da0aa27.en: The policy is mine; the insurer received the application
e499b1701da0aa27.zh: 保单是我的，保险人已收到申请

5d1f0da67f2fc54f.en: Apply Article 11, part 11: a full premium refund by the insurer following timely cancellation under the stated conditions. In the base version, the bank was the policyholder. Here the borrower herself is the policyholder: the recipient of the demand changes, while the receipt date is established separately.
5d1f0da67f2fc54f.zh: 适用第11条第11款，在既定条件下及时退保，由保险人全额退还保费。基础情景中，银行是投保人。本情景中，借款人本人是投保人：请求的接收方发生变化，而收件日期仍须单独确定。

dd5b44d54ee1c0d0.en: Timely cancellation of this individual contract requires a refund by the insurer, not waiting for the bank's approval.
dd5b44d54ee1c0d0.zh: 本个人保险合同已及时申请退保，应由保险人退款，而不是等待银行批准。

85d6b9c4644fe343.en: Match the report to the incident and location
85d6b9c4644fe343.zh: 核对报告对应的事件和地点

e5b5bdc453b0acf4.en: Identify the remaining part of the appeal
e5b5bdc453b0acf4.zh: 识别申诉中尚未处理的部分

49692b0c0a5f0d35.en: Determine the proper route for addressing the waste
49692b0c0a5f0d35.zh: 确定处理废弃物问题的适当路径

af07f14d2c67a201.en: Tell the citizen the actual, not an exaggerated, outcome
af07f14d2c67a201.zh: 向公民告知真实而非夸大的处理结果

a5e8f687670dafe7.en: Check subsequent confirmation for the same location
a5e8f687670dafe7.zh: 核查同一地点的后续确认材料

fa90ec7718e7af82.en: Close the unexamined part concerning the dump
fa90ec7718e7af82.zh: 将尚未审查的垃圾堆问题结案

6db9d4bc3faeb844.en: Declare the area safe without supporting grounds
6db9d4bc3faeb844.zh: 在没有相应依据时宣布该区域安全

3330095259af06db.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. A professional service's report confirms that the particular fire incident has ended. The materials show no current signs of danger. The written appeal also concerns remaining waste; its status and handling route require verification. The student does not certify complete environmental safety or organise the work independently.
3330095259af06db.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。专业部门的报告确认该次燃烧事件已结束。材料没有显示当前存在危险迹象。书面申诉还涉及残留废弃物；其状态和处理路径需要核查。学生不得出具完全环境安全的结论，也不得自行组织作业。

fdcb8085d4ffb8ed.en: A past incident does not establish a current emergency. Resolving one problem, however, does not dispose of the appeal's second issue.
fdcb8085d4ffb8ed.zh: 过去发生过事故并不代表目前仍有紧急情况。但解决一个问题，并不意味着申诉中的第二个事项也已处理。

483582da22dcb194.en: The end of the fire incident is confirmed, but the remaining waste is unresolved. A past incident does not establish a current emergency. Resolving one problem, however, does not dispose of the appeal's second issue.
483582da22dcb194.zh: 已确认燃烧事件结束，但残留废弃物问题尚未解决。过去发生过事故并不代表目前仍有紧急情况。但解决一个问题，并不意味着申诉中的第二个事项也已处理。

302c8c68592d3bea.en: The end of the fire incident is confirmed, but the remaining waste is unresolved.
302c8c68592d3bea.zh: 已确认燃烧事件结束，但残留废弃物问题尚未解决。

10e77b9d8afe1676.en: Extinguishing the fire automatically confirms removal of all rubbish.
10e77b9d8afe1676.zh: 灭火自动证明所有垃圾均已运走。

492df9a09dcec6a3.en: An old fire photograph proves that burning continues now.
492df9a09dcec6a3.zh: 过去的火灾照片证明现在仍在燃烧。

c6f37a7456dcb40f.en: Verify completion at У-32; a neighbouring plot does not prove the outcome for this appeal. A past incident does not establish a current emergency. Resolving one problem, however, does not dispose of the appeal's second issue.
c6f37a7456dcb40f.zh: 核查У-32的执行情况；相邻地块的材料不能证明本申诉的处理结果。过去发生过事故并不代表目前仍有紧急情况。但解决一个问题，并不意味着申诉中的第二个事项也已处理。

6daaa2a213a22644.en: The contractor later sent a removal report for nearby location У-33.
6daaa2a213a22644.zh: 承办方随后提交了附近地点У-33的清运报告。

f8c98e2ad5b50143.en: Verify completion at У-32; a neighbouring plot does not prove the outcome for this appeal.
f8c98e2ad5b50143.zh: 核查У-32的执行情况；相邻地块的材料不能证明本申诉的处理结果。

0bd81fe481518197.en: Accept any removal report from the same district.
0bd81fe481518197.zh: 接受同一区内任意清运报告。

028feb65130278cd.en: Repeat to the citizen that the fire was extinguished some time ago.
028feb65130278cd.zh: 再次告诉公民火早已扑灭。

59b4544957b271dc.en: Declare the entire area cleared on the basis of the fire-extinguishing report.
59b4544957b271dc.zh: 凭灭火报告宣布整个区域已清理完毕。

4657ef0a553c8891.en: Repeat the emergency notification every time without new signs of danger.
4657ef0a553c8891.zh: 没有新的危险迹象也每次重复发送紧急通报。

e8159941c3561a77.en: Find the legal basis for the next action: distinguish the completed operational response from further consideration of the remaining issue.
e8159941c3561a77.zh: 查找下一步行动的法律依据：区分已经结束的现场处置与对剩余问题的后续审查。

5a0c308bcd35fe83.en: Rubbish used to burn here. There is no smoke now, but the dump remains. Can my appeal be closed using the fire-extinguishing certificate?
5a0c308bcd35fe83.zh: 这里之前有垃圾燃烧。现在没有烟了，但垃圾堆还在。能凭灭火证明将我的申诉结案吗？

69aecee470f01a85.en: The professional service completed its response to the specified fire incident. The report concerns У-32 and contains no information about waste removal.
69aecee470f01a85.zh: 专业部门已完成对指定燃烧事件的处置。报告涉及У-32，但不包含清运废弃物的信息。

e5fc5dca7de8a85e.en: The appeal raises two related issues: earlier burning and the remaining pile of waste. Photographs taken after the burning ended show waste at the same location.
e5fc5dca7de8a85e.zh: 申诉提出两个相关问题：此前的燃烧和残留的废弃物堆。燃烧结束后的照片显示，同一地点仍有废弃物。

c1a1d3612142c563.en: It is proposed to close both issues with a single reference to the report that burning ended. There are no materials confirming removal of the remaining waste.
c1a1d3612142c563.zh: 有人建议仅引用燃烧结束报告就将两个问题一并结案。没有证明残留废弃物已清除的材料。

a9fb634cc910ea7b.en: Prepare a decision and actions within the specified role. The materials establish the jurisdictional conditions. Do not prescribe treatment, impose real penalties or send actual appeals. A professional service's report confirms that the particular fire incident has ended. The materials show no current signs of danger. The written appeal also concerns remaining waste; its status and handling route require verification. The student does not certify complete environmental safety or organise the work independently.
a9fb634cc910ea7b.zh: 在指定角色权限内拟定决定和行动。材料已设定管辖条件。不得开具治疗方案、实施真实处罚或发送真实申诉。专业部门的报告确认该次燃烧事件已结束。材料没有显示当前存在危险迹象。书面申诉还涉及残留废弃物；其状态和处理路径需要核查。学生不得出具完全环境安全的结论，也不得自行组织作业。

1e922ec27632ef9f.en: Distinguish the completed operational response from further consideration of the remaining issue.
1e922ec27632ef9f.zh: 区分已经结束的现场处置与对剩余问题的后续审查。

b1a69991229b94ed.en: The fire has stopped; the waste remains
b1a69991229b94ed.zh: 燃烧已停止，废弃物仍在

f12796d468e476a3.en: Distinguish the completed operational response from further consideration of the remaining issue. A past incident does not establish a current emergency. Resolving one problem, however, does not dispose of the appeal's second issue.
f12796d468e476a3.zh: 区分已经结束的现场处置与对剩余问题的后续审查。过去发生过事故并不代表目前仍有紧急情况。但解决一个问题，并不意味着申诉中的第二个事项也已处理。

67ea2eac684f79c0.en: A report that burning ended does not, by itself, confirm waste removal.
67ea2eac684f79c0.zh: 仅凭燃烧结束报告，不能证明废弃物已清运。

da6715e65e0adba9.en: Clarify the location using available safely obtained information
da6715e65e0adba9.zh: 利用现有安全获取的信息核实地点

600ba89e5a853e98.en: Relay the report to the professional duty service
600ba89e5a853e98.zh: 将情况通报专业值班部门

a56c9912d7b5cb2f.en: Record the link between the operational report and the written appeal
a56c9912d7b5cb2f.zh: 记录现场情况通报与书面申诉之间的关联

660fa3c532704c18.en: Do not require the citizen to undertake a dangerous inspection

f78f961d64a3da68.en: Check relevant confirmation and the subsequent non-emergency route
f78f961d64a3da68.zh: 核查相关确认材料及后续非紧急处理路径

716247225bd5e6c5.en: Ask the citizen to approach the fire to take a photograph
716247225bd5e6c5.zh: 要求公民靠近燃烧地点拍照

825c20d51e55372e.en: Leave the current report unrelayed solely because the owner is unknown
825c20d51e55372e.zh: 仅因业主不明而不转报当前情况

7367dce0b4635cac.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. The citizen is in a safe place and reports ongoing burning. The location has been checked using the supplied coordinates without sending the citizen towards the fire. The reception office has an established operational channel to the professional duty service. Environmental and land-related classification is not yet complete; the student does not determine firefighting methods.

1b046f715c734939.en: Article 10 of Law No. 59-ФЗ requires objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, obtaining necessary materials within the body's powers, and measures to protect violated rights. A reply to one point does not establish that other independent issues were considered. The written-reply period is not a reason to postpone reporting a current danger to the professional service.
1b046f715c734939.zh: 第59-ФЗ号法律第10条规定，应客观、全面、及时地审查事项，在职权范围内取得必要材料，并采取措施保护受侵害的权利。答复其中一点，并不能证明其他独立问题已被审查。书面答复期限不能成为延迟向专业部门通报当前危险的理由。

f2f94b0563cda48c.en: An unidentified owner does not prevent immediate relay of a current report whose location is established. The original scenario concerned identifying the territorial recipient. Here a current danger is established, so the operational report is separated from subsequent jurisdictional handling.
f2f94b0563cda48c.zh: 业主尚未查明，不妨碍及时转报地点已确定的当前情况。原情景要确定地域管辖接收方。本情景已确认当前危险，因此须将应急通报与后续管辖处理分开。

74512dfb2f2a5bb2.en: The У-30 coordinates fall within this municipality. The landowner has not yet been identified; the professional duty service accepts reports for these coordinates.

85a8bcd9ccc62726.zh: 核对标识、地点与登记册信息

c69c8a909f01bfe3.zh: 确定正确的地域管辖权

b1ec21866bda68fc.zh: 核对送达确认是否对应指定接收方

c53fb50653303824.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. This is a non-emergency issue concerning a specific facility. The location and supervision regime are confirmed by a complete training extract: the facility is subject to federal environmental supervision, and exact territorial jurisdiction is established. There is no ongoing burning. The student checks real contact details against the reference; fictional violations are not attributed to real organisations.
c53fb50653303824.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。审查的是某一具体设施的非紧急事项。完整教学摘录确认了地点和监督制度：该设施接受联邦环境监督，准确的地域管辖权已确定。目前没有燃烧。学生应通过参考资料核实真实联系方式；不得将虚构违法行为归于真实机构。
